result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but a few visual issues were found: a card is clipped at the right edge of the viewport, the notification bell appears partially cut off at the top edge, and the selected 'Pizza' filter does not match the mixed general content being displayed.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccola' card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visible scroll affordance or peek of subsequent cards.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel shows a partial peek of the next card or a scroll indicator so users understand more content is available horizontally.

issues.description: The notification bell button in the top-right corner appears slightly clipped/tight against the top edge and status bar area.
issues.suggestion: Add more top padding so the bell button has adequate spacing and is not visually cut off.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category filter is selected, but the displayed content (poke bowls, burgers, ramen) does not appear filtered to pizza.
issues.suggestion: Either filter the listings according to the selected category or reset the filter selection to 'All' if filtering is not applied on the home feed.
